rows.en: The ship has completed its descent to Earth. All hands, switch to Level 2 alert status.
rows.notes: Torres addresses all hands with formal ship announcement. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I repeat. The ship has completed its descent to Earth. All hands, switch to Level 2 alert status.
rows.notes: Torres addresses all hands with formal ship announcement. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Phew... Looks like we managed to land on Earth safely.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: ...#女愛称, have you settled in aboard the Nahel Argama?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I wouldn't say I've settled in... It's been one surprise after another.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: What surprised you?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Restored question predicate for echo.

rows.en: Well, for one thing, all the pilots in the famous Gundam Team are kids...
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: And there are girls like you and Ple aboard, too.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I'm amazed you made it through the Neo Zeon and Baam wars with a crew like this.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Was that a dig at us?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: No, not at all. I'm impressed. You've actually gotten results.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Results... I don't know what to say to that.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Restored speaker reaction to the results label.

rows.en: We aren't fighting because we want to...
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: A lot happened, and we just ended up aboard this ship...
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Preserved deliberate trailing account.

rows.en: I understand that. But whatever your reasons... You got results by surviving.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: That's what I'm honestly impressed by.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: That's a soldier talking. We're not trying to climb the ranks in the military, you know?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: With the world the way it is, I suppose we have no choice...
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Restored we as children forced to fight; trails into row18.

rows.en: But once the war's over, we want to go back to living in peace, like before.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: They're the opposite of me... But of course they are. They're at an age when they should be in school.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. They refers to Gundam Team children, not Leina alone.

rows.en: Anyway, are you and #男愛称... maybe a couple, #女愛称?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Both lead nickname placeholders retained; dating question targets female lead.

rows.en: Huh?
H-hey, Beecha! It's rude to just spring a question like that on her.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Oh, what's the harm? So, are you, #女愛称?
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Sorry to disappoint you. We're just partners. Partners.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Partner means working partner, not romantic partner; emphatic repetition retained.

rows.en: Besides, I prefer someone older to someone younger.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Older romantic age preference follows dating question; no gender restriction added. Meaning review: kept age preference without specifying gender absent from source.

rows.en: Oh... Okay.
rows.notes: Female lead chats with Leina, Beecha and Iino; candid curiosity, defensiveness and teasing resolved from adjacent replies. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: All hands, Level 3 battle stations. Mobile suit pilots, board your units and stand by.
rows.notes: Torres addresses all hands with formal ship announcement. Battle stations distinct from alert status in rows0-1.

rows.en: I repeat...
rows.notes: Torres addresses all hands with formal ship announcement. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Looks like we're finally about to meet up with that transport fleet.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: They're carrying new machines, right? What sort of machines are they?
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Are you interested in them?
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Well... It comes with the job.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Restored interest arising from test-pilot occupation.

rows.en: The new machines are nicknamed D-Weapons... Their real name is Dragonar, and there are three types.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Dragonar... Three types... Let me guess: close combat, long-range support, and mid-range support?
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Incorrect third guess retained; row34 corrects it.

rows.en: Sorry, you got the last one wrong. It's for electronic warfare.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Hmm... So the idea is for three machines to work as a set and handle all kinds of combat situations.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Restored technical concept as an idea for three machines.

rows.en: The Federation Ground Forces are really putting work into developing their next mainstay machine.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Wrong again. The D-Weapons were made by Giganos.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I hear their designer, Dr. Plato, brought them over to the Federation.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Source short surname follows locked Dr. Lang Plato spelling. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: I see... So that's why this ship was assigned to escort them.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Exactly. Though I hear the D-Weapons have already been used in combat.
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: To master the enemy's latest machines like that...
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Deliberate trailing setup completed in row42; retained as fragment.

rows.en: Their pilots must be incredibly skilled elites...
rows.notes: Female lead asks Beecha/Iino about D-Weapons; informed professional interest and casual correction. Plural pilots grounded in three machines; no gender assumption.

rows.en: Our orders have changed... Commander?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Respectful question to commanding officer.

rows.en: Yes. It's a request from the General Staff.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I understand we're to transport the D-Weapons to Chongqing Base in China aboard this ship.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: But... Why do we have to carry EVA-02 to the Port of Yokosuka?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked. Final terminology review: official Yokosuka City source confirms Port of Yokosuka; remeasured.

rows.en: Apparently, the D-Weapons' transport fleet and its transport fleet happened to be on nearby routes.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Its fleet refers to EVA-02; two fleet routes happen to be close.

rows.en: So they asked us to take it along, through the upper levels of the Federation government.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. They refers to NERV from row50; requests routed through Federation leadership.

rows.en: Just take it along...?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Your ship is more flexible than a surface vessel. That must be what caught NERV's eye.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: If it's just transport, that's one thing. But what do we do if something happens?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Actually, something already has.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Already happened means encounter described next.

rows.en: Twelve hours ago, EVA-02's transport fleet encountered an Angel at sea... They reportedly destroyed it.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Reported destruction refers to Angel; preserved twelve hours and at sea.
Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Wordless shocked reaction retained.

rows.en: But the transport ship was badly damaged in the battle. It's now stranded at sea.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Transport damaged in Angel engagement, now stranded.

rows.en: That's why they contacted you and the D-Weapons' transport fleet.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: ...Understood. So we should stop in Japan, then head for Chongqing Base?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Dedup reply also agrees on route-specific questions, so plain affirmative.

rows.en: And... What's the situation in Japan now?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: The three great empires... The Mycenae, Dinosaur, and Demon Empires have ceased all activity, but...
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Three empire titles preserve glossary forms; sentence continues row61.

rows.en: Angels and mysterious unidentified flying objects have been appearing.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: What about TOKYO JUPITER, the impenetrable barrier covering all of Tokyo?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Restored what about question; absolute barrier rendered impenetrable.

rows.en: There's been no noticeable activity, just as in the past dozen or so years... But it's only a matter of time.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Activity refers to TOKYO JUPITER, not three empires.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Soon, the Federation's Far East Forces and TERRA, the anti-MU strategic research agency, will launch a major operation.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Full TERRA descriptive agency role retained before measurement.

rows.en: Are they planning to invade the inside?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. They refers to Far East Forces/TERRA; invasion inside barrier restored.

rows.en: Yes. They've asked our Space Forces for support, too...
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Support requested of speaker naval service; direction retained.

rows.en: Depending on how things go, we may need you to take part in the operation.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: ...Understood.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: ...Captain Bright. First the postwar cleanup after the Baam war, and now this mission...
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Deliberate setup carries into apology row71. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: I truly am sorry that I can't even give you any leave.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: Normally, I should send the Nadesico B, which is under my direct command, but right now it's...
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Deliberate trailing ship-status clause answered row73.

rows.en: I'm aware. It's out conducting trial operations for the Hisago Plan, correct?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: I plan to have it join you as soon as that's done... But I'll send reinforcements to help you before then.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. It refers to Nadesico B; both reunion and earlier reinforcements retained.

rows.en: What reinforcements do you mean?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Restored what do you mean predicate.

rows.en: Would you know who I mean if I said the heroes of the war against the three great empires?
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Heroes identifies Mazinger/Getter/Raideen confirmed by alternate route. Meaning review: restored full conditional question predicate.

rows.en: Yes, of course.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Subject/action restored where Japanese elides them; neighbor response checked.

rows.en: And there's one more thing...
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Deliberate lead-in to row79. Meaning review: restored existential verb in lead-in.

rows.en: I hear you went out of your way to send flowers for my daughter.
rows.notes: Bright and Misumaru discuss changed transport orders and Japanese operations; formal command exchange, then personal apology and thanks. Flowers for deceased daughter; next row80 confirms death anniversary. No present-tense gift implication.

rows.en: Yes... The anniversary of her death was approaching.
rows.notes: The flowers mark the approaching anniversary of Yurika's death; alternate route names her.

rows.en: I'm sorry to have put you to that trouble, Colonel.
Not at all... I never had the chance to meet your daughter in person, but...
rows.notes: Retains the source trailing transition before row83.

rows.en: She played a vital part in bringing the Lizard War to an end.
If the armistice with the Jovian Federation hadn't been signed after that, the Earth Sphere would be in far worse shape now.
I'm sure my daughter would be glad to hear that from you, the former captain of the White Base...
rows.notes: Yurika is the daughter; the White Base reference addresses Bright.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Well then, Captain Bright. I'm counting on you to take good care of things.
rows.notes: Misumaru asks Bright for care and cooperation; request direction preserved. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
...Yes, we received that report here as well.
She had help from the D-Weapons, but she destroyed the Angel just 36 seconds after launching... before her internal power ran out.
rows.notes: Asuka is the pilot; alternate-route context resolves the subject. Hidden caller remains ???.

rows.en: She's quite something.
She had better be.
However, all that action came at a cost: one Federation carrier and one battleship were heavily damaged...
rows.notes: Damage applies to one carrier and one battleship; source trails off.

rows.en: I expect the bill will go to Branch 3. Will that be all right?
I've already made arrangements with the committee. Besides... it's a small price to pay for defeating an Angel.
So far, everything has followed the plan... I wonder what happens next?
That depends on whether Operation Overlord, which TERRA is about to launch, succeeds.
I've obtained some new information about that operation.
I'll give you my report when I get there.
rows.notes: Restores caller's report action and destination from Gendo conversation.

rows.en: Yes.
Also, I've sent Captain Katsuragi to the carrier Aquapolis to take delivery of EVA-02.
uncertain: Aquapolis ship spelling pending centralized sourcing.

rows.en: Leave the rest to her, and bring that item here.
rows.notes: The item remains deliberately unidentified.

rows.en: Understood. I'll see you shortly...
Lieutenant, I've brought Captain Katsuragi.
Thank you, Sergeant.
I'm Captain Misato Katsuragi, Section 1, Operations Bureau, Tactical Operations Department, Special Agency NERV Headquarters.
rows.notes: Preserves all nested organizational affiliations; formal self-introduction.

rows.en: I've come aboard the carrier Aquapolis to accompany EVA-02 on its transport mission.
uncertain: Aquapolis ship spelling pending centralized sourcing.

rows.en: I'm Lieutenant James C. Douglas, commander of the D-Weapons transport unit. You're as beautiful as I've heard.
N-no, I... Wait, who told you that?
He did.
Hey, Katsuragi!
Wha...!
rows.notes: Source interrupted interjection retained.

rows.en: Long time no see.
W-w-w-why are you here!?
I'm escorting Asuka. I'm here on business from Germany.
I let my guard down...! I should have seen this coming...
Well, that's quite a greeting.
...I heard about it. You gave EVA-02 permission to sortie, didn't you?
I gave permission... or she just went out on her own... Call it a decision made in the field.
rows.notes: Kaji equivocates between giving permission and Asuka launching herself.

rows.en: That doesn't mean you had to wreck the ships!
Tell that to the Angel. We never expected to run into one out at sea, either.
That's right, Misato. It wasn't Kaji's fault.
Asuka...!
It's been a while. How have you been?
Well enough. Haven't you grown taller, too?
Yep. The rest of me is looking more womanly, too. Right, Kaji?
rows.notes: Asuka boasts about physical maturation to Kaji; not limited to height. Meaning/style review: avoids awkward phrasing while keeping the claim of maturation elsewhere on her body. No fit-driven shortening.

rows.en: Yes. I'm sure the boys will be all over you once you get to Japan.
...But I'm not interested in any man other than you, Kaji.
...Captain Katsuragi. May I give you my report now?
Huh? Oh... I-I'm sorry. Go ahead.
EVA-02 has already been transferred from the carrier Over the Rainbow to this ship, the Aquapolis...
rows.notes: Source trails into the next row; one row per source retained.
uncertain: Aquapolis and Over the Rainbow ship spellings pending centralized sourcing.

rows.en: All that remains is to wait for the Nahel Argama to arrive.
Understood. Are there any problems?
According to the Nahel Argama team's report, a Giganos mobile task force has descended into the waters around here.
! Could they be after the D-Weapons?
rows.notes: Restores Giganos task force as subject from previous row.

rows.en: Yes. As things stand, we'll be in trouble if the enemy arrives before the Nahel Argama team.
How will you deal with them?
We'll deploy the D-Weapons... the Dragonars.
Whaaat!? That trio of clowns!?
rows.notes: Insult begins three-person banter.

rows.en: What!? Who are you calling a trio of cons, huh!?
rows.notes: Sound-based misunderstanding recreated as clowns/cons; not a literal lexical match.
uncertain: Wordplay adapted: source confuses tonchiki (fools) with inchiki (frauds); clowns/cons preserves the misunderstanding.

rows.en: Kaine, she said clowns. Clowns.
rows.notes: Tapp corrects the misunderstanding from row139.

rows.en: Either way, it's still an insult!
Exactly. I'd prefer you at least call us the Three Musketeers.
The Three Musketeers? The Three Stooges is good enough for you!
rows.notes: Three Stooges carries the three-fools insult and contrast with Three Musketeers.

rows.en: My, those are harsh words. And I resent being lumped in with Kaine and Tapp.
Hey, Light! What's that supposed to mean!?
Don't act like you're the only cool one here.
Hey, you lot! Stop this pointless bickering in front of your superior officers!
U-um... Lieutenant Douglas, who are they?
rows.notes: Restores the identity question from Misato's surprise.

rows.en: ...They're the Dragonar pilots I mentioned earlier.
What!?
I can't blame you for being surprised. But there are a number of circumstances involved.
Yeah, circumstances deeper than the sea.
rows.notes: Retains Kaine's sea-depth exaggeration.

rows.en: It was a coincidence... or just how things turned out.
More to the point, you were ordered to stand by in your Dragonars. Why are you here?
We heard a beautiful commanding officer was coming aboard, so we wanted to pay our respects before taking our stations.
Exactly. Let us introduce ourselves, Sergeant.
We should meet face to face, to confirm the chain of command.
rows.notes: Restores the action of meeting to confirm command structure.

rows.en: Confirm what? You never do anything like that normally...
It's all right. Airman Third Class Wakaba, introduce yourself quickly, then return to your post.
rows.notes: Airman Third Class rank confirmed centrally against Japan MOD rank chart; Wakaba is Kaine.

rows.en: Yes, ma'am! Captain Katsuragi, I'm Airman Third Class Kaine Wakaba!
rows.notes: Formal introduction to Misato; rank preserved.

rows.en: I pilot Dragonar-1! I look forward to serving under you, ma'am!
rows.notes: Kaine asks for future cooperation as a subordinate; serving under you preserves request direction.

rows.en: Airman Third Class Tapp Oceano, pilot of Dragonar-2, reporting!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: I'm Airman Third Class Light Newman. I'm the pilot of Dragonar-3.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: I'm Captain Misato Katsuragi. We'll only be together until we reach Japan, but I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Misato introduces herself to D-Team and asks for cooperation through the voyage to Japan.

rows.en: Only until Japan...? I'd love for us to have a long relationship.
rows.notes: Light turns the short voyage into a flirtatious request for a lasting relationship.

rows.en: We'll save that for another time.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: By the way, Misato. Did you bring the EVA's socket?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Yes, just in case.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Then I don't need those three stooges protecting me anymore.
rows.notes: Asuka calls D-Team three stooges; protection is no longer needed once external EVA power is available.

rows.en: You called us idiots again, didn't you? I've had it with you!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: What's wrong with calling an idiot an idiot?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Shut up! Whoever calls someone an idiot is the real idiot!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: What did you say!?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Good grief, they're fighting like children. ...Anyway, Captain Katsuragi, what is this EVA socket?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: It's what we need to connect the EVA's umbilical cable to an external power source.
rows.notes: Socket connects the EVA umbilical cable to external power, not the cable directly to the EVA.

rows.en: With that, the EVA can operate longer than it can on its internal power supply.
rows.notes: Restored EVA as subject; external versus internal power determines operating time.

rows.en: I see... So you plug a power cord into the machine itself.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: But doesn't that mean the EVA can't go very far from its power source?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Right. That's a teensy little problem.
rows.notes: Teensy keeps Misato informal and understates the tether limitation.

rows.en: So it's on a leash. It's like a dog out for a walk.
rows.notes: The leash/dog comparison refers to the tethered EVA.

rows.en: What the hell do you think EVA-02 is!?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: It's the world's first real Evangelion, built for actual combat to save the future of humanity!
rows.notes: Asuka stresses first real combat Evangelion and humanity's future.

rows.en: It's nothing like your machines!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: ...Yes, it is.
rows.notes: Yes, it is contradicts Asuka's claim that EVA-02 differs fundamentally from the Dragonars.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: We need the Dragonars to protect Earth from those Giganos bastards, too.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Yeah. It's just like Second Lieutenant Guineer said.
rows.notes: Restored it is; callback to the Dragonars' role in protecting Earth.
uncertain: Guineer spelling awaits centralized terminology confirmation.

rows.notes: Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: We decided to take the Dragonars to Chongqing so we can end this war as soon as possible.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: I don't know how it looks to you, but we're not doing this for fun, you know?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Wh-what's with you, trying to act so cool? You look like an idiot.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Sheesh, you just never shut up, do you? You could learn a thing or two from Linda.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Who's Linda?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Huh? Uh... She's my girlfriend... I guess?
rows.notes: Kaine tentatively calls Linda his girlfriend; next two rows expose it as wishful thinking.

rows.en: Hey, hey! Since when are you two that close?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Hmm... We will be... I guess?
rows.notes: We will be restores the future relationship answered in row195; the joking hesitation remains.
uncertain: Future relationship with Linda inferred from row195; preserves Kaine's joking uncertainty.

rows.en: Hah! You sure talk big.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: What about you? How are things with Rose?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Well, we're getting there, I guess.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: So, really... who is Linda?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Oh, she and Rose are girls who fled here from the Moon.
rows.notes: Linda and Rose are female refugees per glossary and explicit source girls; she refers to Linda.

rows.en: They were with us until we came down to Earth on the transport ship Idaho.
rows.notes: We is D-Team; they is Linda and Rose; Idaho is their transport to Earth.

rows.en: Huh... Where are they now?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: I hear they're helping with medical work at a refugee camp.
rows.notes: They remains Linda and Rose; heard report rather than firsthand knowledge.

rows.en: Ah, my darling Linda... I want to see you.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.
Source shock punctuation retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: Are we under attack!?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: It's a Giganos Metal Armor unit! Wakaba, you and your team launch now!
rows.notes: Metal Armor unit means enemy formation; you and your team is Wakaba and his teammates.

rows.en: Roger! Let's go, Tapp! Light!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Yeah!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Well then, let's show Captain Katsuragi what our D-Team can do!
rows.notes: D-Team flatters Misato and plans to demonstrate its combat ability.

rows.en: I'm going out, too!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: No, you're not.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Why not? We can connect the cable now, right!?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: We're out at sea... and EVA-02 still has its B-type equipment.
rows.notes: B-type equipment is current standard equipment, not underwater equipment; next row explains limitation.

rows.en: An Angel attacking from underwater would be one thing, but you can't handle Metal Armors that can fly.
rows.notes: An underwater Angel is the contrasting hypothetical; flying Metal Armors are the current foe.

rows.en: We won't know that until I try!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: W-wait a minute! Asuka!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: ...That's youth for you.
rows.notes: Youth refers to Asuka rushing out despite Misato's orders; restored a complete English clause.

rows.en: How can you be so carefree...!?
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: You don't need to worry so much. With Kaine and the others there, she'll be fine.
rows.notes: She is Asuka, whom Misato is worried about; Kaine and teammates can protect her.

rows.en: Will she really be okay?
rows.notes: Restored Asuka's safety as the question settled by row221.

rows.en: I saw them in action last time, and they were quite impressive.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: You'd never guess they were civilians until just recently.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: They were civilians? No wonder...
rows.notes: Restored they were; No wonder... preserves the source's deliberately unfinished explanation.

rows.en: They aren't just relying on their machines' performance or luck. They've got real skill, too.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: That's why they've managed to survive this long.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: You mean they're like Amuro Ray?
rows.notes: Amuro is the comparison for untrained civilian pilots with innate talent.

rows.en: I doubt they're Newtypes, but they're like him in that they had no training beforehand.
rows.notes: The parallel is lack of prior training, not confirmed Newtype status.

rows.en: In other words, they have a natural talent.
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Shinji Ikari, EVA-01's pilot, is like that too, isn't he?
rows.notes: Shinji is the explicitly named parallel; gender is sourced in glossary.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat-condition UI row, not spoken dialogue; grammatical condition matches source; no @ in source.

rows.en: Come and get some, you Giganos bastards!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Airman Third Class Wakaba, we've received word from the Nahel Argama team.
rows.notes: Nahel Argama team is the incoming allied force, not just its ship.

rows.en: They'll reach these waters in about three minutes. You have to hold out until then.
rows.notes: They refers to the incoming Nahel Argama team; D-Team must hold out three minutes.

rows.en: Just watch, Lieutenant. We'll wipe out those Giganos bastards ourselves before help even gets here!
rows.notes: Context and speaker retained; complete spoken English with source tone.

rows.en: Wait, Kaine. It might not be that easy.
rows.notes: Light's warning anticipates the Blue Hawk of Giganos revealed in source241.

rows.en: Well, well, Light. Are you getting cold feet?
rows.notes: Kaine mockingly challenges Light's courage, not a literal cold sensation.

rows.en: Didn't you say you wanted to show off in front of Captain Katsuragi?
...I checked the enemy data with D-3. The one coming here is... the Blue Hawk of Giganos.
What!?
L.C.L.Fullng. Anfang der Bewegung.
rows.notes: German startup recitation retained in ASCII to preserve the language callback in 247-248; source spelling is malformed.
uncertain: Source German startup wording appears malformed; ASCII transliteration retained without speculative correction.

rows.en: Anfang des Nerven anschlusses.
rows.notes: German startup recitation retained; technical nominal command, not dropped conversational subject.
uncertain: German neural-connection wording appears nonstandard; retained source Latin wording.

rows.en: Ausloses von links-Kleidung. Sinkio-start.
rows.notes: German startup recitation retained; source spelling is malformed.
uncertain: Source German startup wording appears malformed; ASCII transliteration retained without speculative correction.

rows.en: Hey, she's going out there too?
More importantly, what... language is that?
It's German. She's one-quarter Japanese, with German ancestry.
rows.notes: Quarter refers to Japanese ancestry; other ancestry described without inventing an exact German fraction.
uncertain: The source only calls Asuka a Japanese-German quarter; allocating the Japanese quarter is an inference about heritage requiring review.

rows.en: You sure get your information fast.
Well, that's part of my job. Now, shall we get back to my real work?
Asuka, listen. The cable limits your EVA's range, so I want you to support the D Team.
And another thing...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished lead-in, interrupted by Asuka in 253.

rows.en: You're going to say I can only move for three minutes if I disconnect the cable, right? I know that much.
Everyone, watch out! Enemy units are entering this airspace!
Captain, look at that!
Yes... the Dragonars are flying. When did they learn to do that?
rows.notes: Restored Dragonars as subject of the surprised timing question; flying ability is the referent.

rows.en: Oh, great. Light was right. And those rich boys are with him, too.
They followed us all the way to Earth...! Damn, these guys just won't give up!
Who are those guys?
An ace pilot called the Blue Hawk of Giganos, and the rich boys who tag along with him.
rows.notes: Nominal answer to Asuka asking who the pilots are in 259; retained source answer fragment.

rows.en: Blue Hawk? He looks more purple to me.
Purple Hawk probably just doesn't have the same ring to it.
...Listen, all of you. Our targets are strictly the D-Weapons. Do not attack the carrier.
Why, sir? That ship is carrying NERV's new weapon, the Evangelion.
It may someday threaten our Giganos. We should take this chance to destroy it!
No. As they say, if you chase two rabbits, you catch neither. Focus on the D-Weapons.
rows.notes: Rabbit proverb preserved; no invented strategic explanation.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
All right, begin the attack!
Gah! I can't risk pursuing them any farther...!
All units, we're pulling back!
Let's see how much your skills have improved, Dragonar pilot!
You bastards followed us all the way out here! You just don't know when to quit!!
That machine is not yours to do with as you please, you wretch!
What are you talking about? I'm handling it just fine, as you can see!
You dare face me in a machine like that!
Sure, it isn't built for combat... but its eyes and ears are sharper than yours!
So this is the Evangelion. It might be worth testing its power, but...
rows.notes: Source trails off after considering a test of EVA power.

rows.en: I don't care if you're the Buzzard or the Hawk of Giganos!
rows.notes: The concessive attack taunt continues in 279; kite/buzzard versus hawk wordplay retained.

rows.en: Don't get cocky just because you can fly!
A golden mobile suit...! I believe it's Quattro Bajeena's... No, it must be the Red Comet's machine.
rows.notes: Meio recognizes Quattro as the Red Comet; correction within the source preserved.

rows.en: Then you're a worthy opponent!
Is this the new model Karl and the others reported...?
That Metal Armor moves differently from the others...! Is that because of its performance?
Or is it the pilot's skill...!?
rows.notes: Alternative question continues the performance-versus-pilot contrast in 283.

rows.en: It's both. If you don't stabilize it in the blue zone, we'll be the ones shot down!
rows.notes: The blue zone is the TE Engine gauge operating region, as confirmed by root; do not interpret it as geography.
uncertain: Exact English blue-zone label remains a literal operational rendering pending a source-backed glossary entry.

rows.en: I-I'll find a way to do it!
I have no use for the little chicks trailing after the Hawk!
You little...! Are you treating us like raw recruits!?
I'll show you just how much of an advantage attacks from above give you in atmospheric combat!
I don't have to fly to swat the flies buzzing overhead!
We of the Practice Squad are the chosen elite. Defeat is impossible!
rows.notes: Practice Squad matches glossary; chosen-elite boast preserved.

rows.en: Then I'll make the impossible happen!
Damn you, Dragonar! Today I'll pay you back for everything you've done!
Shut up, rich boy! I'm going to avenge old man Chekhov!
rows.notes: Chekhov spelling confirmed centrally from MAHQ episode6 and official Japanese character label; old man is Kaine's affectionate label.

rows.en: Chekhov? Ah... our army's lieutenant at that experimental station.
rows.notes: Dan identifies Chekhov as his own army's lieutenant, not an enemy officer.

rows.en: We killed him because he interfered with our mission!
rows.notes: The killed lieutenant is Chekhov, settled by 295.

rows.en: What the hell are you talking about!? You shot the old man just to grab the glory for yourselves!
rows.notes: Credit-seeking accusation retained at full force.

rows.en: Watch me, Lieutenant Chekhov! I'll crush this guy with the fighting techniques you taught me!
rows.notes: Kaine addresses the dead Chekhov; avenging him using the training he gave Kaine.

rows.en: Heh! Did the rich boy come all this way just to get beaten?
Silence! Today I'll put an end to your smart mouths!
Dragonar! Your devil's luck runs out today!
We're not amateurs anymore! I'll make you realize that!
You guys just don't know when to quit!
Silence! Your resistance forced the captain and us to come all the way to Earth!
You guys sure work hard, coming all the way down to Earth just to chase us.
It's all because you refuse to hand over the Dragonars quietly!
No matter how much firepower you have, if I can just get in close...!
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional fragment: Welner leaves the outcome unstated, Tapp interrupts in 308.

rows.en: Whoa! I'll pick you off before you can do that!
If I shoot you down, the cornerstone of the D-Weapons, the battle is ours!
rows.notes: D-3 is the D Weapons' information/support cornerstone; target is Light.

rows.en: Spoken like a true elite. But that gives me all the more reason not to let you shoot me down!
Dragonar! I will kill you myself!
Well, well. You're awfully hot-blooded for a rich boy.
You're still trailing after the Blue Hawk like fish poop, aren't you?
rows.notes: Literal scatological hanger-on insult retained as fish poop instead of sanitizing it.

rows.en: You bastard! You'll pay with your life for insulting the captain and us!
Those movements...! I see you're a veteran whose skills were forged in real combat...!
rows.notes: Meio addresses Judau; battle-tested experience is answered in 316.

rows.en: I've been through my share of hell, too!
rows.notes: Singular speaker subject supplied; Judau answers Meio's appraisal in 315.

rows.en: I don't care if you're the Blue Hawk of Giganos. Get lost already!
So this is Giganos's ace... But I can't let you beat me!
That's the spirit! But you'll learn that spirit alone can't bridge the gap in our abilities!
If I shoot down Giganos' ace, I'll be the ace this time! Let me at you!
You won't bring down my Falguen with your petty thirst for glory!
You're too slow!
H-hey! You're the one who's too fast!
Whoa! Th-this guy's fast!!
This is a battlefield. If you must lament something, lament your own helplessness!
I-it can keep up that kind of maneuverability even in the atmosphere...!
rows.notes: Restores the Falguen as the subject; maneuverability is maintained within the atmosphere.

rows.en: This is the might of the Metal Armors Giganos takes such pride in... Our swords to bring the hammer down on the Federation!
I don't care who you are! I won't let you attack us!
rows.notes: The battle exchange settles the omitted action as Meio attacking the allied force.

rows.en: What!? The Federation sends even little girls onto the battlefield!?
Underestimate me because I'm a kid, and you won't get away with just an injury!
rows.notes: Keeps the threat that the outcome will be worse than injury; does not soften it.

rows.en: This pilot... isn't a Newtype or anything... but really knows how to fight!
rows.notes: Keeps the pilot gender-neutral; Ple Two assesses ability rather than claiming Newtype powers.

rows.en: You sensed my presence. But even knowing I'm coming, you cannot escape!
Aquapolis to all units! The Nahel Argama team is here!
All right! Now we've turned the tables!
All units, launch! Support D Team and the fleet!
They've caught up with us...
Oh, so that's the Gundam Team.
They're the unit that beat Neo Zeon's leader, right?
Yeah. They beat Haman Karn herself.
rows.notes: Restores the Gundam Team as subject and defeating Haman as the action answered from row338.

rows.en: I wonder what kind of people they are.
I bet they're a bunch of tough-looking guys like Sergeant Ben.
Oh, I don't know. Maybe they'll surprise us and turn out to be a bunch of gorgeous ladies.
So those are the Dragonars... Giganos' new weapons.
Their pilots must be elites, so their combat data should be useful.
rows.notes: Female protagonist assumes the Dragonar pilots are elites; this is her supposition, not narration.

rows.en: Then again, #男愛称 might not be interested.
If you've got time to worry about other people's data, get the engine output adjusted properly.
rows.notes: Male protagonist asks his co-pilot to adjust their engine; request direction retained.

rows.en: I-I know that!
rows.notes: Female lead objects to being lectured; stutter retained.

rows.en: Honestly...! Does he think I'm that unreliable?
rows.notes: Thought; he is the male protagonist responding to her data suggestion.

rows.en: If the battle drags on, we'll be at a disadvantage...
All units. Our priority now is to hold them up. Concentrate your attacks on the Nahel Argama.
1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Thanks to the Nahel Argama team, it looks like we'll make it through somehow...!
Huh? Where's Kaji?
Hey, Katsuragi!
Kaji!?
I've got something to deliver, so I'm going on ahead.
See you! I'm leaving the rest to you, Captain Katsuragi!
rows.notes: Kaji leaves Misato responsible for the remaining situation; request direction retained.

rows.en: D-did he run away...?
Th-that idiot!!
We mustn't push our luck any further.
But we did manage to hold them up. All units, we're pulling back!
The enemy Metal Armor force has withdrawn!
Good... All units, go on alert. Bring us down on the water alongside the Aquapolis.
Roger!
...Well, that was quite an eventful voyage.
So... what information do you have on TERRA's Operation Overlord?
You were right, Commander. The counteroffensive against the Mu is just a cover...
rows.notes: TERRA counteroffensive is the public cover story, not its actual objective.

rows.en: TERRA intends to seize the OOPArts and the people connected to them from the Mu.
OOPArts... So it's the lost mechanical god.
rows.notes: Restores identifying predicate; mechanical god kept as the source metaphor.

rows.en: I've heard that one half has already been found. Is that true?
rows.notes: One half refers to the OOPArts discussed in rows366-367; no more specific identification added.

rows.en: It's your job to get that information out of Bahbem.
Well, yes, it is.
Still... TERRA left TOKYO JUPITER alone for over ten years, and now...
rows.notes: Deliberately trails off across the source row boundary; question continues in row372.

rows.en: Why are they finally making a move? Is it connected to the appearance of the Angels after all?
It's mere coincidence. Their preparations are simply complete.
But if TERRA succeeds in seizing the OOPArts, the Committee won't stand idly by, will it?
We anticipated this when TOKYO JUPITER appeared and Second Impact followed.
The Committee will likely advance its plans according to the other scenario.
rows.notes: Other scenario renders the alternate action schedule; no invented title supplied.

rows.en: Now either side can destroy the other's keystone by force...
rows.notes: Gendo proposes destroying the opposing side keystone; Kaji supplies the second option in row379.
uncertain: The exact TERRA-side keystone is not identified in this exchange; the source metaphor is preserved.

rows.en: Or move the hands of the clock ahead before the other side does, right?
rows.notes: Retains clock metaphor and row-boundary alternative to row378.

rows.en: Yes. Either way, the process will change depending on the outcome of TERRA's operation.
Just as the Angel attacked the EVA-02 transport fleet at a location different from the one planned.
rows.notes: Angel attack location deviated from the schedule; no specific planned place is supplied.

rows.en: Was its target... this?
rows.notes: This refers to the delivered Adam specimen revealed by rows384-387.

rows.en: It's already been restored this far. It's encased in hardened Bakelite, but... it's alive. There's no doubt about that.
rows.notes: Restored specimen is alive inside hardened Bakelite; retains emphatic certainty.

rows.en: ...It's the keystone of the Human Instrumentality Project, then.
rows.notes: Restores the specimen as subject and identifying verb.

rows.en: That's right.
It's the first human... Adam.
rows.notes: Restores identifying subject and verb for Adam.

rows.en: Captain Bright, we'll arrive at the Port of Yokosuka in one hour.
rows.notes: Port of Yokosuka follows root-sourced official Yokosuka City terminology.

rows.en: Understood.
Thank you for going to all this trouble, Captain Bright Noa.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Don't mention it. It's my duty.
Still, it's an honor to meet the famous captain of the White Base in person like this.
...That was a long time ago, Captain Katsuragi.
By the way... where is Captain Amuro Ray now?
He's on another assignment. He isn't aboard this ship.
I see...
Captain, we have an incoming transmission from Commander Misumaru.
Put him through.
Colonel, I see you've safely rendezvoused with the D-weapon transport fleet.
Yes, sir.
rows.notes: Reply to Misumaru confirming the fleet rendezvous.

rows.en: Koichiro Misumaru... Commander-in-chief of the Federation Space Force.
rows.notes: Misato identifies the admiral in private thought; Federation Space Force is the compositional source label.

rows.en: I've heard he's had close ties to Nergal Heavy Industries since before the Lizard War, but...
rows.notes: He refers to Misumaru. Uses glossary-sanctioned Lizard War variant; source trails off.

rows.en: ...I'll get straight to the point. I've just received a formal request from TERRA's Director Shirow Watari.
rows.notes: Misumaru received the request from Watari, not the reverse.

rows.en: You and your forces will be taking part in their Operation Overlord.
rows.notes: Order directed to Bright and his forces.

rows.en: So it has come to that, as I expected. What will our mission be?
TERRA's Commander Jin Kunugi will probably explain the details to you as well, but...
rows.notes: Trailing explanation, continued by row 407.

rows.en: Apparently, you'll provide rear support for the squadron breaking into TOKYO JUPITER.
rows.notes: Rear support for the penetrating squadron, not a penetration order for Bright.

rows.en: Then we won't need to enter that absolute barrier ourselves. Is that correct?
rows.notes: Bright asks whether his force remains outside the barrier.

rows.en: Then, Commander Misumaru... what happens to our mission to transport the D Weapons to Chongqing?
You'll resume it once Operation Overlord is over... though the outcome may bring changes to the mission.
rows.notes: Mission resumes after Overlord, with outcome-dependent changes retained.

rows.en: Besides... we've also had reports of aliens other than the Baam appearing in the Japan region.
rows.notes: Baam denotes the alien people; no gender inferred.
Source is a bare exclamation symbol; preserved as a reaction fragment.

rows.en: Aliens other than the Baam, eh...
rows.notes: Deliberate internal echo of the alien report; noun phrase retained.

rows.en: Then you're saying it's all right if the D Weapons arrive late?
For now, Operation Overlord takes top priority.
Also, the Earth Force reports that production facilities for those mass-production models aren't fully ready yet.
rows.notes: Earth Force distinguished from Space Force; unnamed mass-production model remains unnamed.

rows.en: Mass-production models... Could he mean mass-produced Dragonars?
rows.notes: Misato speculates about the Dragonar mass-production model; preserves uncertainty as a question.

rows.en: In other words, you want us and the D Weapons to serve as decoys and buy time...?
rows.notes: Douglas asks whether his own force and the D Weapons must act as decoys.

rows.en: To put it bluntly, yes. That's what it comes down to.
That's just like what happened in the One Year War...
rows.notes: One Year War callback is Bright recalling his own earlier service.

rows.en: ...The Earth Federation Army is bearing the brunt of problems on all sorts of fronts.
The Space Force was busy cleaning up after the Neo Zeon and Baam wars, and Giganos exploited that opening to invade Earth...
rows.notes: The Space Force was occupied with war aftermath; Giganos exploited its distraction. Source trails off.

rows.en: The Earth Force lost all face in the battles against the Angels. That's all the more reason we can't let Operation Overlord fail.
rows.notes: Angels are the Evangelion enemies; loss of face and inability to permit failure both retained.

rows.en: I see. So that's why the civilian super robots are coming aboard my ship.
rows.notes: Civilian super robots uses campaign term convention.

rows.en: With their combat records, and your unit's, the General Staff has set its expectations far too high.
rows.notes: Their refers to arriving civilian pilots; General Staff expects too much of them and Bright.

rows.en: I've tried all sorts of persuasion and pulled what strings I could, but...
rows.notes: Misumaru tried persuasion and behind-the-scenes lobbying; source trails off.

rows.en: Whenever there's trouble, they turn to Gundams and super robots... To put it unkindly, they treat you as handymen.
rows.notes: Handymen conveys the derogatory convenient-fix-it treatment. Subject and action restored.

rows.en: You're always in the spotlight, so they intend to use you to draw the enemy's attention.
...Understood. We're used to being treated as handymen.
This may not make up for it, but... I've asked GEAR to support you.
rows.notes: Misumaru asked GEAR to support Bright; request direction preserved.

rows.en: GEAR... I believe it's a research institute studying a defense network for the Earth Sphere against alien invasions...
rows.notes: Bright identifies GEAR and trails off before questioning its forces.

rows.en: But I thought they had no fighting forces?
...Officially, they don't.
rows.notes: Restores GEAR has no fighting forces as the understood proposition; officially preserves hidden-capability hint.

rows.en: Officially?
rows.notes: Intentional one-word echo question retained.

rows.en: For the details on that, too, speak to GEAR's Chief Shibuya.
NERV, TERRA, and now GEAR. This is getting complicated.
rows.notes: Private thought, not spoken dialogue.

rows.en: He managed to secure GEAR's cooperation... Commander Misumaru really is as formidable as the rumors say.
rows.notes: He refers to Misumaru; rumor concerns his capability and connections.

rows.en: With their support, the super robot pilots who'll soon be arriving on your ship should find it easier to operate in all sorts of ways.
rows.notes: Operational freedom/support benefit retained; no claim that GEAR directly pilots the arriving machines.

rows.en: Understood. What should we do with the Evangelion and #機体名?
rows.notes: Runtime unit placeholder retained exactly.

rows.en: Deliver the EVA to Yokosuka before you make contact with TERRA.
Otherwise, we'll get on the wrong side of the lady beside you, and of NERV.
rows.notes: The lady beside Bright is Misato; NERV and Misato would resent failure to deliver EVA.

rows.en: ...Thank you for your consideration.
As for #機体名, the Earth Force has requested that your unit continue using it. You may do so.
rows.notes: Unit can continue using the prototype at Earth Force request.

rows.en: You're letting us use such a valuable prototype...?
rows.notes: Restores you are letting us use as settled by preceding permission.

rows.en: Apparently, the purpose is to collect combat data.
Understood. Then, once we've finished unloading EVA-02 at Yokosuka...
rows.notes: Source sentence continues across row boundary into 447; trailing clause retained.

rows.en: We'll rendezvous with TERRA's special-service aircraft carrier, the Lilia Litvyak.
rows.notes: Continues 446 with rendezvous order. Root sourced franchise carrier spelling Lilia Litvyak at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_RahXephon_characters; no Akurasu carrier entry found.

rows.en: N-no way...
rows.notes: Deliberate stammered astonishment fragment retained.

rows.en: You guys are...
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted identification fragment retained, completed in 451 after Judau interjects.

rows.en: The Dragonar pilots!?
rows.notes: Completes Judau identification begun in 448; You are understood in intentional astonished label.

rows.en: That Gundam Team!?
rows.notes: Completes Kaine identification begun in 449; intentional astonished label.

rows.en: What a surprise. I never imagined those things were being piloted by kids about our age...
rows.notes: Roux addresses the Dragonar pilots; machines and pilots restored.

rows.en: That's our line! Gundams are the Federation's secret weapons, right?
I've heard they swung a hammer around and smashed 50 Zakus, or knocked out 120 Doms in three minutes...
rows.notes: Gundam rumor; preserves hammer, 50 Zakus, 120 Doms, three minutes, and trailing continuation.

rows.en: And now you're telling me the pilots of those things were kids!
rows.notes: Pilots are the young Gundam Team; earlier rumor does not literally transfer Amuro feats to Judau.

rows.en: Wow! Judau, can a Gundam really do all that?
rows.notes: Ple asks Judau whether the Gundam can perform the claimed feats.

rows.en: No, that's way too much of an exaggeration.
rows.notes: Removed draft-added even for a Gundam; source simply calls the stories exaggerated.

rows.en: Well, if you think about it calmly, even Amuro Ray was apparently only fifteen or sixteen when he piloted the first Gundam...
rows.notes: Amuro was fifteen or sixteen on first Gundam; source trails into 459.

rows.en: So maybe it isn't really that surprising.
Exactly! We're all about the same age, so let's get along, huh?
rows.notes: Kaine proposes friendly relations between similarly aged pilots.

rows.en: Yeah, I'd like that too.
rows.notes: Reciprocal response to getting along, not an offer to be relied on.

rows.en: I hope we'll be good friends!
rows.notes: Ple greets the newcomers and hopes to get along; avoids reversal of request direction.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Huh? What's wrong?
rows.notes: Ple notices female lead silence in deduplicated prologue-owned row 475 at original i00r2a:102.

rows.en: ...You weren't expecting the Dragonar pilots to turn out to be kids, were you?
rows.notes: Male lead asks female lead about the young Dragonar pilots.

rows.en: Y-yes. Weren't you surprised, too?
rows.notes: Female lead asks male lead if he shares her surprise.

rows.en: I was about their age when I first went into battle myself.
rows.notes: Male lead refers to his own first combat experience.

rows.en: Oh, I see...
By the way, who is that lady with you?
rows.notes: Light asks about the female lead; source explicitly calls her a lady.

rows.en: Oh, they're #女愛称 and #男愛称, the pilots of #機体名.
rows.notes: Judau introduces both leads as the named unit pilots; exact three runtime placeholders retained.

rows.en: I'm Airman Third Class Light Newman. It's a pleasure to meet you.
rows.notes: Sourced Airman Third Class rank supplied by root; full glossary name Light Newman.

rows.en: Likewise... I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名.
rows.notes: Self-introduction reciprocal greeting; second lieutenant rank and runtime full name preserved.

rows.en: I'm #男姓名. By the way, I watched you in that last battle...
rows.notes: Male lead introduces himself then refers to their just-completed battle; trailing lead-in retained.

rows.en: All three of you are so skilled, it's hard to believe you were civilians until just recently.
rows.notes: All three refers to Kaine, Tapp, Light; civilian recency and skill retained.

rows.en: Really? Maybe I ought to have more confidence in myself!
Lieutenant, please don't flatter him too much. It'll only go to his head even more.
rows.notes: Light warns the male lead not to flatter Kaine; him is context-settled.

rows.en: But that goes for Judau and his friends, too... Luck alone wouldn't have kept you alive this long.
rows.notes: Extends praise to Judau and companions; luck alone is insufficient.

rows.en: By the way, on another subject... #女愛称, why are you dressed like that?
rows.notes: Kaine asks female lead about her revealing pilot suit; does not call it a swimsuit before explanation.

rows.en: Here it comes... The usual comment about my outfit.
rows.notes: Private thought anticipating the familiar remark about the outfit.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly. Even if we are out at sea...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing sea/swimsuit allusion answered by Roux in 480; source omission retained.

rows.en: That's a pilot suit, though it does look just like a swimsuit.
rows.notes: Roux answers Kaine477 and Tapp479 about the female lead's apparent swimsuit.

rows.en: Wow... The Federation military sure has a sense of style.
Even though #男愛称's clothes look pretty normal.
rows.notes: Tapp contrasts the male lead's clothing with the female lead's pilot suit.

rows.en: Normal... do they?
rows.notes: Thought: female lead questions whether the male lead's clothes count as normal; copula preserved.

rows.en: I'm a man. Please spare me from having to wear that outfit.
rows.notes: Male lead refuses hypothetical swimsuit-like outfit for himself; request subject/direction retained.

rows.en: You've got a point there.
Oh, come on! You all think it's funny because you're not the one wearing it!
rows.notes: Female lead objects to the others treating her outfit as someone else's problem.

rows.en: By the way, Kaine...
rows.notes: Deliberate lead-in to489; Kaine interrupts with naming preference in488.

rows.en: You can just call me Kaine, Lieutenant. So, what is it?
rows.notes: Honorific naming distinction localized as just calling him Kaine; Lieutenant follows explicit source rank.
