rows.en: Where's the Evangelion pilot?
rows.notes: English restores complete location question about Asuka.

rows.en: Oh, she boarded the liaison plane with Captain Katsuragi from NERV.
They're getting off with the Evangelion at the Port of Yokosuka.
rows.notes: Asuka and Misato are the people getting off; no new gender inference. Port of Yokosuka confirmed centrally by official city map.

rows.en: Can I ask something? That pilot was a girl, right? How old is she?
I heard she's fourteen.
F-fourteen?
S-she's young, too...
This is the bridge. Special units will be landing on this ship shortly. Deck crew, prepare to receive them.
rows.notes: Special units renders 特機 distinctly here to preserve499-500 definition exchange; contextual departure from general super robot convention. Root approved contextual distinction for this definition exchange.

rows.en: ...Is someone coming aboard?
Yes, some people who'll be helping us out.
More importantly, what's a special unit?
rows.notes: Term clarification, not a new unrelated special unit;500 defines super robot. Root approved contextual distinction for this definition exchange.

rows.en: It's what people usually call a super robot.
rows.notes: English restores referent subject/verb for term definition.

rows.en: Huh...
Look, look, Judau! A big UFO and a little UFO are coming!
Yeah. That doesn't look like it was built on Earth. Could it belong to the Baam?
rows.notes: Ambiguous UFO demonstrative retained as that; identification as Baam technology is Judau's speculation, not a fact.

rows.en: And that red robot... Isn't that Getter Robo?
Getter Robo?
rows.notes: Bare repeated name is a genuine confused echo question.

rows.en: You don't know it? It was fighting that lizard army down here until just recently.
rows.notes: Lizard army is deliberately generic here;507 misreads it as Jovian Lizards,508 corrects Dinosaur Empire.

rows.en: Lizards... You mean the Jovian Lizards?
rows.notes: Jovian Lizards follows existing glossary explanatory note; misunderstanding preserved.

rows.en: No, no. The Dinosaur Empire.
So this is the Nahel Argama, the Federation's newest ship. It's bigger than I expected.
Yeah. They couldn't operate our machines if it wasn't this big.
You've got a point.
Huh? Could that guy be...?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished recognition before Tapp identifies Koji513.

rows.en: I recognize him, too. You're Mazinger Z's pilot, right?
Yeah, that's me. I guess I'm pretty famous, huh?
You were on the TV news and everything when you were fighting Dr. Hell and Mycenae, Koji.
rows.notes: Mycenae is shortened organization reference, not an added personal name.

rows.en: So were you and Hayato and the others, Michiru.
Heh... All that attention got people making a fuss about us, though...
rows.notes: Hayato trails off about unwanted publicity;518 completes the contrast.

rows.en: Now that we're here, we'll be free of that nuisance.
Yeah, true.
They look about the same age as us, too.
rows.notes: Roux compares incoming Getter/Koji youths with her group; female lead's age discomfort521/559/560 is the callback.

rows.en: Y-yes, they do...
rows.notes: Stammering agreement retains age-related discomfort;560 settles reason.

rows.en: Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Koji Kabuto, the TFO's pilot.
Huh? Where's Mazinger Z?
It's in the robot museum now.
A museum, huh? So that's why you're flying that UFO.
It's a TFO. TFO. I built it when I was at the Watson Science Institute in America.
rows.notes: TFO repetition corrects Kaine's generic UFO label. Watson Science Institute requires centralized source.
uncertain: Watson Science Institute is a faithful literal name for the Grendizer institute; no canonical English entry found centrally.

rows.en: Huh... So it was built on Earth.
Yeah. Pretty cool, huh?
The color and shape look a bit like an Asshimar.
rows.notes: Asshimar spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Z Unit List.

rows.en: Asshimar... You mean that Titans mobile suit!?
rows.notes: Asshimar spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Z Unit List.

rows.en: Then did you build that big UFO too, Koji?
N-no, that's... Anyway, let me introduce the other members.
rows.notes: Koji evades disclosure of large UFO origin and changes subject; source hesitation retained.

rows.en: The guy next to me is from the Getter Team...
rows.notes: Koji's introduction deliberately trails off before Hayato534 completes it.

rows.en: I'm Hayato Jin. I pilot Getter Liger.
Then is that red one the Liger?
No, that's the Dragon. I'm Benkei Kuruma, Getter Poseidon's pilot. I look forward to working with you.
rows.notes: Benkei names his form, distinguishes Dragon from Liger, and requests good future relations; direction preserved.

rows.en: Poseidon? Liger? What's going on?
Getter Robo is made of three fighters that combine and transform into three different forms.
Hayato pilots the Liger, the form for high-speed ground combat...
rows.notes: Trailing list item continues into540, with subject and pilot action restored.

rows.en: Benkei pilots Poseidon, the form for underwater combat.
So it's like the Dragonars combining, then transforming into D-1 or D-2?
rows.notes: Kaine offers an analogy rather than claiming Dragonars actually combine.

rows.en: The Dragonars combining... That might be pretty cool.
rows.notes: Conditional idea of combination retained; English restores evaluative copula.

rows.en: What are you talking about? Building one machine with the strengths of all three makes more sense.
rows.notes: Light says one machine combining advantages is more realistic, not three physically combining.

rows.en: ...I should have introduced myself sooner. I'm Michiru Saotome. I support Ryo and the others.
rows.notes: Ryo nickname retained because545 immediately echoes it; referent is Ryoma547. Source explicitly supplies nickname; retained to preserve the echo question.

rows.en: Ryo?
rows.notes: Bare nickname echo question, retained as source fragment.

rows.en: Perfect timing. Here he comes.
...I'm Ryoma Nagare, Getter Dragon's pilot. I look forward to working with you.
rows.notes: Ryoma introduces himself; request direction expressed as speaker anticipating working with listeners.

rows.en: I'm Roux Louka. Behind me are the D Team and Gundam Team members.
rows.notes: Group introduction intentionally lumps together the members, prompting549 complaint.

rows.en: Hey, you just lumped us all together!
By the way, Ryo... Where's Daisuke?
rows.notes: Ryo refers to Ryoma; question subject restored. Source explicitly supplies nickname; retained to preserve the echo question.

rows.en: He went ahead to see this ship's captain. I'll go and greet the captain with him.
rows.notes: Daisuke went ahead to Bright; Ryoma says he will go greet Bright with Daisuke.

rows.en: Okay, got it.
...It sounds like there's one more person who came with you.
Yeah, his name is Daisuke Umon...
rows.notes: Daisuke introduction trails into Ple's555 identification.

rows.en: He's the pilot of that big UFO, right?
That's right.
...Um, this might be rude to ask, but... how old is he?
rows.notes: Female lead asks Daisuke's age, continuing Asuka age discussion492-495; male gender supported by Daisuke glossary.

rows.en: Well... I don't know exactly, but I'd guess he's around twenty.
rows.notes: Koji estimates age; do not turn estimate into fact.

rows.en: Twenty...
rows.notes: Bare age echo retains stunned reaction; next thought560 explains eldest concern.

rows.en: Th-then... am I the oldest one here?
rows.notes: Thought: female protagonist realizes she is older than the gathered pilots after the age discussion.

rows.en: Captain, we're almost finished unloading EVA-02.
Understood. ...Now, is it true that aliens other than the Baam have appeared?
Yes. The UFOs that have been appearing so often over Japan lately were Vegan Empire reconnaissance craft.
rows.notes: UFOs over Japan were reconnaissance craft, not unidentified allies.

rows.en: The Vegan Empire...
King Vega assembled their forces to conquer the entire universe.
Did you say... conquer the entire universe?
That's quite an ambitious undertaking.
Then are you saying this King Vega has set his sights on Earth next?
Yes. If nothing changes, they'll conquer Earth.
Yes... Earth will fall just like all the other planets King Vega has set his sights on...
rows.notes: Restores Earth and its conquest from row569 while retaining the comparison and trailing pause.

rows.en: ...There's one thing I'm wondering about.
What is it?
You look like an Earthnoid to me... So why do you know about the Vegan Empire?
rows.notes: Douglas questions Daisuke about apparently being an Earth-born person; appearance does not reveal his hidden identity.

rows.en: I've been wondering that myself...
And Daisuke's Grendizer seems different from the Mazingers Koji and the others use...
rows.notes: Thought: Ryoma contrasts Grendizer with the Mazingers; it is his impression.

rows.en: ...That's because my father, Dr. Genzo Umon, has been investigating them.
rows.notes: Daisuke gives Genzo Umon as his father and researcher; no hidden identity revealed.

rows.en: ...I see.
But this is troublesome. A new group of aliens has appeared just as we're about to begin Operation Overlord...
...In any case, we'll need the super robot team to join the Federation's operation too. Is that all right?
rows.notes: Bright asks the super robot team to take part in the Federation operation.

rows.en: Yes. We know you're fighting to preserve peace in the Earth Sphere.
I... have no objection either.
...The Vegan Empire forces aren't the only aliens targeting this planet...
rows.notes: Daisuke hints at another alien threat.

rows.en: If the rumors I heard before coming to Earth are true, they too...
rows.notes: Thought: unfinished rumor about other aliens follows reused stage01 owner476; identity/action not supplied beyond source.
uncertain: The exact rumor and the unfinished they too predicate are not explained here; no completion or more specific identity supplied.

rows.en: These are difficult times. I hope we can make peace with the Vegan Empire as we did with the Baam.
What!? Did you say... make peace!?
rows.notes: Renders the initial startled punctuation as a spoken exclamation.

rows.en: What's wrong?
You can't reason with them! They're devils!
rows.notes: Retains devils and the categorical rejection of negotiation.

rows.en: D-Daisuke!?
They... the Vegan Empire...!
rows.notes: Angry unfinished accusation retained before Ryoma intervenes.

rows.en: Daisuke, calm down!
...! I'm sorry... Ryo...
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.

rows.en: W-what!? Musashi... is dead!?
Yes... He died a noble death, like a true man...
rows.notes: Retains the masculine ideal in Saotome's description of the death.

rows.en: What happened, Ryo!?
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.

rows.en: ...It was all... my fault...
Th-then, the Vegan Empire killed him...!?
rows.notes: Restores killing from Musashi's stated death and the Vegan Empire agency.

rows.en: Yes...
Th-that's impossible! You're saying Getter Robo was beaten!?
I'm sorry, Koji... I'm the leader. It's my fault Musashi was killed...
rows.notes: Ryoma accepts responsibility as leader; does not claim he personally attacked Musashi.

rows.en: ...Ryo, it isn't just your fault. Back then, Musashi was trying to save me...
rows.notes: Hayato trails off while explaining that Musashi tried to save him. Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.

rows.en: Stop it, both of you. I'm the commander. All the responsibility lies with me.
B-but...!
Stop blaming yourself, Ryo.
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.

rows.en: There are things in a person's nature you can't hold back, even if you try to stop them...
rows.notes: Saotome refers to irrepressible personal nature, in context Musashi's impulse to save others.

rows.en: Musashi gave up his own life so that two others could live.
rows.notes: Explicitly identifies the sacrificed life as Musashi's own; retains two lives saved.

rows.en: D-damn it...! Why... why did this have to happen!?
Koji...
rows.notes: Thought: compassionate address to Koji, intentionally just a name.

rows.en: If I'd... realized who they really were sooner...!
rows.notes: Counterfactual trails off as in source; no invented consequence.

rows.en: Koji... I know how you feel, but we don't have time to mourn his death.
rows.notes: Daisuke says there is no time for mourning, not that grief is wrong.

rows.en: They... the Vegan Empire will come here again.
B-but still!
If we leave those devils alone, more people will suffer the same grief as you...
Right now, we have to grit our teeth and find a way to fight them.
...He's right.
Grieving alone won't let us honor Musashi's sacrifice...
Hm!?
Father, unidentified flying objects are heading for the Institute!
rows.notes: Institute is Saotome Institute; unidentified flying objects are plural as confirmed by the enemy appearance.

rows.en: Put the images on the main monitor!
Y-yes!
Th-that's... the Vegan Empire!!
I knew they'd come...!
rows.notes: Thought: Daisuke expected the Vegan Empire attack.

rows.en: I'm going to avenge Musashi! I'm heading out!!
Koji, stay here. Your TFO is no match for them.
rows.notes: Koji is told to remain because the TFO cannot contend with these enemies.

rows.en: What!?
...If anger alone could win battles, we'd have no trouble. Calm down.
rows.notes: Daisuke admonishes Koji to calm down, preserving the conditional anger argument.

rows.en: Daisuke, you might not know this, but I've fought alongside Musashi again and again!
They killed a dear friend of mine! How can I just stand down and keep quiet!?
I see. In that case...!
rows.notes: Daisuke's unfinished response precedes incapacitating Koji.

rows.en: Ugh... Daisuke...! You...
rows.notes: Groan and interrupted address retained; no completed accusation invented.

rows.en: ...Koji, don't hold this against me. If you launch in your state, you'll only get yourself killed.
rows.notes: Daisuke protects Koji by stopping an angry suicidal launch.

rows.en: ...You're not planning to say that to us too, are you?
rows.notes: Male protagonist challenges whether Daisuke also intends to stop his team.

rows.en: But you have a mission you need to carry out, don't you?
rows.notes: Daisuke reminds the protagonists of their test mission; no invented mission details added.

rows.en: ...I've had more than enough of leaving my fate in someone else's hands.
rows.notes: Male protagonist alludes to earlier reliance on others; no unsupported event added.

rows.en: Huh...? What does he mean?
rows.notes: Thought: female protagonist questions the male protagonist's allusion.

rows.en: So I'm heading out too.
...All right. I'll be counting on your help.
rows.notes: Daisuke requests the protagonists' help; direction remains Daisuke asking them.

rows.en: Dr. Saotome, we're launching in the Get Machines too!
rows.notes: Ryoma proposes launching with the component aircraft rather than a combined Getter Robo.

rows.en: Ryo...!
rows.notes: Saotome addresses Ryoma using source nickname Ryo.

rows.en: I'm sorry, but leave this to us.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Ryoma to entrust this fight to him and the protagonists; request direction preserved.

rows.en: But they're the ones who killed Musashi!
rows.notes: Ryoma wants to avenge Musashi.

rows.en: Ryoma, I've also seen people I loved killed right before my eyes...
rows.notes: Daisuke recalls witnessing the deaths of loved ones; no additional identities inferred.
Bare surprise exclamation retained.

rows.en: So I believe I understand how you feel.
rows.notes: Daisuke understands Ryoma and his companions.

rows.en: Please hold back for now, so you'll be ready for the battles ahead against the Vegan Empire...!
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Getter team to restrain themselves now for future battles, not to abandon vengeance.
Silent emotional reaction with forceful ending retained.

rows.en: Damn...! Are we really stuck just standing by and watching...!?
rows.notes: Ryoma laments inability to join combat in obsolete Get Machines.
Saotome silence retained.

rows.en: ...Michiru, bring Benkei here.
rows.notes: Saotome directs Michiru to summon Benkei.

rows.en: What!? B-but...!!
rows.notes: Michiru interrupted protest retained.

rows.en: ...It's ahead of schedule, but we're putting the secret plan into action...!
rows.notes: The secret plan is advanced ahead of schedule.

rows.en: A secret plan...!?
rows.notes: Echo question naming the secret plan retained.

rows.en: Yes.
To honor Musashi as well, we must crush the Vegan Empire's ambitions with our own hands.
rows.notes: We refers to Saotome and Getter allies; honoring Musashi and personally crushing Vegan ambitions both retained.

rows.en: Yes, with a new Getter Robo...!
rows.notes: Deliberate follow-on phrase specifying new Getter Robo; no omitted source verb needs restoring.

rows.en: A new Getter Robo...!?
rows.notes: Hayato echoes new Getter Robo as a question.

rows.en: Excuse me!
rows.notes: Benkei enters the room politely; Excuse me fits the entrance greeting.

rows.en: You're here, Benkei.
Doctor, who is he...!?
rows.notes: Ryoma asks the identity of the arriving Benkei; question subject and verb restored.

rows.en: Let me introduce him. While we've been working on the secret Getter project, he's been training hard as a reserve team member...
rows.notes: Secret-project timeline and reserve training retained; introduction continues across row boundary to 662.

rows.en: He's Benkei Kuruma.
rows.notes: Completes Benkei introduction using full glossary name.

rows.en: D-do you mean...!?
rows.notes: Ryoma interrupted inference retained.

rows.en: That's right. He'll be the third pilot of the new Getter Robo.
rows.notes: Benkei is third pilot of the new Getter Robo.

rows.en: You're replacing Musashi...!?
rows.notes: Hayato protests Benkei replacing Musashi; restored explicit action.

rows.en: Doctor, you're telling us to just accept that...!?
rows.notes: Hayato addresses Saotome, not Benkei.

rows.en: Don't turn away from the truth, Hayato! We must carry on Musashi's wishes and face this new threat!
rows.notes: Saotome orders Hayato to face the truth and carry on Musashi wishes.

rows.en: That's the only way we can honor his death...!
rows.notes: That refers to continuing the fight, not accepting Benkei alone.

rows.en: Doctor...!
rows.notes: Emotional vocative retained.

rows.en: Let me help you carry on his wishes. I've inherited Musashi's love of peace and his guts, too.
rows.notes: Benkei asks to join fulfillment of Musashi wishes; peace-loving heart and guts retained. Honorific senpai omitted under campaign convention.

rows.en: So please, let me fight alongside you!
rows.notes: Benkei asks the existing team to let him fight, not an offer to be relied on.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Now... Come out, Grendizer. I know you're here.
rows.notes: Battle-map event 4: Barendos calls Grendizer out.

rows.en: #男愛称, I'll draw them off! You go defend the institute!
rows.notes: Duke directs male lead to defend institute while Duke draws enemies off.

rows.en: No, you can't handle that many alone. The best defense is a good offense... That's how we'll do this!
rows.notes: Male lead refuses defensive assignment because Duke cannot face the numbers alone; offense-as-defense idea retained.

rows.en: Duke Fleed! So you've been living in disgrace on this remote little planet!
rows.notes: Insult and disgrace retained at full force.

rows.en: Who are you!?
I'm Barendos, captain of King Vega's Royal Guard! Remember that name on your way to hell!
rows.notes: King Vega Royal Guard rank retained; afterlife-souvenir idiom rendered as death threat.

rows.en: Shut up! I'll never hand this beautiful green planet over to devils like you!
rows.notes: Duke refuses to surrender Earth; devils insult and beautiful green description retained.

rows.en: If we take this one down, their whole force should fall apart...! #女愛称, keep the power up!
rows.notes: Male lead expects enemy collapse on destroying commander; asks female lead to maintain output.

rows.en: Yes, I know!
You fool! Do you think you can bring down this Motherburn with a saucer like that!?
rows.notes: Barendos taunts Koji saucer against Motherburn, not protagonist unit.

rows.en: Shut up! This is just the right handicap for me!
rows.notes: Koji boasts disadvantage is suitable handicap.

rows.en: Now, you'd better brace yourself...!
rows.notes: Hayato threatening enemy; restored explicit you subject.

rows.en: This Earth, which Musashi gave his life to protect...
rows.notes: Deliberate noun phrase continues with Ryoma row 685; Earth and Musashi sacrifice retained.

rows.en: As long as we and Getter Robo are here, we'll never hand it over to you!
rows.notes: Completes Earth defense declaration following Benkei row 684.

rows.en: You impudent fools! I'll make you suffer just like last time!!
rows.notes: Barendos threatens repeat of earlier Getter defeat.

rows.en: You... You're the one I can never forgive! Now I'll avenge Musashi!!
rows.notes: Koji repeated refusal to forgive Barendos preserved; explicit avenge Musashi ending.

rows.en: Musashi...! I'll avenge you right here and now!!
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses deceased Musashi and vows vengeance.

rows.en: Musashi, this is my tribute to you...! I'll show you that bastard falling into hell...!!
rows.notes: Hayato addresses deceased Musashi; threat of enemy falling to hell retained.

rows.en: Musashi, watch us! We'll avenge you with our own hands!!
rows.notes: Benkei asks deceased Musashi to watch. Restores avenge verb settled by the battle; no honorific added.

rows.en: I'll give you a hand, Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Event 10: Koji arrival and aid to Duke.

rows.en: Koji...! Why did you come out!?
rows.notes: Duke asks why Koji disobeyed stay-behind request.

rows.en: Just so you know, I'm not so soft that a punch like that could put me out of action.
rows.notes: Refers to Daisuke punch before battle; changed for good to put out of action to avoid permanent/death implication.

rows.en: And I'm not so cowardly that I'd just stand and watch while my friends fight.
rows.notes: Koji rejects cowardly spectatorship while allies fight.

rows.en: But in that TFO...!
rows.notes: Duke interrupted concern about TFO ability retained.

rows.en: I poured my heart and soul into building this saucer. It's as much a part of me as my own arms and legs.
rows.notes: Koji refers to his own hand-built TFO saucer; heart-and-soul effort and limb analogy retained.

rows.en: So you don't need to worry about me.
...All right. If you insist, I won't try to stop you anymore. ...I'm sorry I punched you earlier.
rows.notes: Duke stops opposing sortie and apologizes for earlier punch.

rows.en: It's all right! Now, let's go!!
Heh heh heh, that's enough of this sideshow.
rows.notes: Event 11: enemy reinforcement escalation; malicious laugh and sideshow dismissal retained.

rows.en: I'll slaughter you just like I did that red robot...!
rows.notes: Red robot refers to prior Getter defeat, not newly arriving Getter Dragon.

rows.en: W-what is that!?
rows.notes: Female lead reacts to enemy reinforcement, not the later Getter arrival.

rows.en: It isn't a Saucer Beast...!?
rows.notes: Saucer Beast category denied; restored explicit it subject.

rows.en: That's it! Because of that thing, Musashi...!!
rows.notes: Michiru emotional unfinished statement retained rather than completing its deliberately broken ending; Grangen caused Musashi death, established in surrounding vengeance lines.

rows.en: Now go, Sky Beast Grangen! Send Duke Fleed and those Earthlings to the very depths of hell!!
rows.notes: Barendos orders Sky Beast Grangen to kill Duke and Earthlings; hell-depth threat retained.

rows.en: That's the one that killed Musashi...!!
rows.notes: Koji identifies Musashi killer.

rows.en: And it's their trump card!
rows.notes: Male lead identifies Grangen as enemy trump card.

rows.en: All right, everyone, concentrate your attacks on it!
rows.notes: Duke orders concentrated fire by all allies.

rows.en: Right!!
Wait! We'll take that thing down ourselves!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? despite next rows settling Getter team arrival.
Bare surprise/interrogation symbols retained.

rows.en: Oh, you've combined successfully!!
rows.notes: Saotome recognizes successful Getter combination.

rows.en: Mach Wiiing!!
rows.notes: Canonical Mach Wing confirmed by root at https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/X-Omega/Abilities. Mach Wiiing!! preserves source elongated deployment shout.

rows.en: Th-that is...!?
rows.notes: Duke interrupted recognition retained.

rows.en: Could that be Getter Robo...!?
rows.notes: Female lead speculates whether arriving robot is Getter Robo.

rows.en: Yes...! This is the new Getter... Getter Dragon!
rows.notes: Ryoma identifies new Getter Dragon.

rows.en: Impossible...! You mean you already had a new machine ready!?
rows.notes: Barendos shocked new machine was already prepared.

rows.en: Ryo, Hayato, Benkei, listen carefully.
rows.notes: Saotome addresses three pilots; Ryo source nickname retained.

rows.en: That Getter Robo has ten times the power of the old Getter.
rows.notes: New Getter has ten times old Getter power; following row720 assigns effective use to pilot skill.

rows.en: Whether you can make full use of that power depends on your own skills.
rows.notes: Dr. Saotome addresses Getter Team; that power refers to tenfold power stated719.

rows.en: Understood, Doctor! We'll use this machine to beat them, I promise!
rows.notes: Ryoma promises to use Getter Dragon to defeat enemies, rather than requesting someone else do it.

rows.en: Are you ready, Hayato, Benkei!?
Yeah!
You bet!
Here I come, monster! We're going to avenge Musashi!!
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses monster and avenges Musashi; literal anger retained. Current campaign_terms Musashi Tomoe confirms spelling and sourced male gender.

rows.en: D-damn them...! I had no idea they had that much power!
We have no choice! Pull Motherburn back!
rows.notes: Retreat order targets Motherburn ship, not a character.

rows.en: I-impossible... They defeated Grangen! Damn it, retreat! We're retreating!
rows.notes: Short Grangen name preserved without adding Sky Beast epithet absent here; retreat order retained.

rows.en: We did it! Musashi, we've avenged you!
rows.notes: Benkei addresses deceased Musashi; honorific dropped without dropping reverence.

rows.en: Musashi, we won...!
...Getter Robo has been reborn...
rows.notes: Getter rebirth is explicit subject, contrasting previous machine destruction.

rows.en: So, Musashi... Rest in peace...
rows.notes: Deliberate pause before request for dead Musashi to rest peacefully.

rows.en: ...Musashi, did you see that? Everyone worked together, and we defeated that monster.
rows.notes: Saotome addresses deceased Musashi; everyone working together causes monster defeat.

rows.en: Though the price we paid was far too high...
rows.notes: Price refers to Musashi death, not expenditure; source trailing clause retained.

rows.en: Look, everyone... It's the first star of the evening.
A star coming out at this hour... Did Musashi turn into a star and come to cheer us on?
rows.notes: Hayato treats unusual star as Musashi cheering them on; tentative question preserved.

rows.en: Yeah. For all his size, he had a gentle, romantic side to him.
rows.notes: Musashi male referent is source-linked by736; his gentle/romantic side contrasts physique.

rows.en: Musashi... I'll carry on your wishes.
rows.notes: Benkei pledges to carry on deceased Musashi's wishes; source senpai respect remains in sincere tone.

rows.en: So watch over us from the distant sky... and all the battles ahead of us...
rows.notes: Koji asks deceased Musashi to watch their future battles; English subject/verb of appeal retained.

rows.en: Everyone, let's hold our heads high, so our pledge can reach Musashi.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks living group to stand proud so their pledge reaches deceased Musashi.

rows.en: Yeah...!
Musashi, we'll never forget you.
And we'll protect the Earth you loved. I swear it to you, now that you've become a star...!
rows.notes: Ryoma promises to protect Earth and swears to Musashi as a star; metaphor retained.

rows.en: ...It's been a while, Commander Ikari.
rows.notes: Scene shifts to Kaji/Gendo report; Ikari surname and rank are explicit in source.

rows.en: Unit-02 is on its way to Yokosuka aboard the Nahel Argama, which joined the convoy en route.
Though I slipped away while everyone was busy. I feel bad for leaving Katsuragi to handle it.
rows.notes: Kaji left convoy during activity and acknowledges leaving Katsuragi in the lurch.

rows.en: It doesn't matter. What you're carrying takes priority.
...Still, we were attacked by an Angel and Giganos... It was quite an eventful voyage.
I've received the reports. Unit-02 appears to have operated without any problems.
Even with D-Weapons fleet support, she destroyed the Angel 36 seconds after launch... before her internal power ran out...
rows.notes: Asuka is subject of destroying Angel, settled by751; retains36sec, fleet help, internal-power deadline. Measured draft overflow4 lines; tightened fleet support wording and time emphasis, preserving concession, subject/action,36sec and power limit.

rows.en: Asuka really is impressive.
But the Angel battle and later Giganos attack heavily damaged one Federation carrier and one battleship...
rows.notes: Exactly one carrier plus one battleship heavily damaged; not sunk or destroyed. Measured draft overflow4 lines; tightened battle descriptors, retaining sequence, one of each ship, heavy damage and trailing ending.

rows.en: I expect the bill will go to NERV Branch 3. Will that be all right?
rows.notes: NERV Branch3 is literal numbered branch label; no extra branch location invented. Root confirms compositional NERV Branch 3 follows existing Branch 1 naming pattern; no location invented.

rows.en: I've settled it with the committee. Besides... if we defeated the Angel, it's a small price to pay.
rows.notes: Committee bill arrangement settled; monetary cost cheap relative to defeating Angel.

rows.en: Everything's gone in order so far... What comes next, I wonder?
About that... Your prediction was right, Commander.
That operation's counterattack against Mu is just a cover...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished explanation;758 gives true operation goal.

rows.en: TERRA intends to seize the OOPArts and the people connected to them from Mu.
rows.notes: Mu is antecedent of them via757; OOPArts and associated people retained with glossary spelling.

rows.en: I hear one of the pair has already been found. Is that true?
rows.notes: One of a pair refers to mysterious lost-machine OOPArts discussed in original515 inserted before759; no guessed identity.
uncertain: Paired OOPArts referent intentionally unspecified; one of the pair is inferred from inserted515 lost-machine description.

rows.en: Why are they making their move now...? Does it have something to do with the Angels appearing, after all?
rows.notes: Route insertion519 establishes TERRA had waited over ten years; they/TERRA is restored as mover.

rows.en: We could predict this when TOKYO JUPITER appeared and the Second Impact occurred afterward.
rows.notes: Gendo responds to inserted Kaji522 warning of committee reaction; not a claim forecasting the Angel itself.

rows.en: The committee will likely proceed with its plan according to another timetable.
rows.notes: Another timetable renders alternate course of plans without inventing named document.
uncertain: Another timetable could refer to a specific in-world plan document; source only gives generic action-table wording.

rows.en: Yes. Either way, the process will change depending on the outcome of TERRA's operation.
rows.notes: Yes answers inserted527 about advancing the clock before the other side, not adjacent fresh762.

rows.en: Just as the Angel attacked the Unit-02 transport fleet somewhere other than the expected location.
rows.notes: Analogy to changed Angel attack location keeps complete predicate; follows process variation763.

rows.en: ...Captain Bright, the offloading of EVA-02 will be finished shortly.
Then, Captain Katsuragi... I'll leave the rest to you.
rows.notes: Bright asks Misato to take responsibility for remaining EVA transfer; direction preserved.

rows.en: Yes, sir. Thank you for your cooperation with NERV.
It's fine. It was our duty.
Please also give my regards to the children in the D Team and Gundam Team who supported Asuka.
rows.notes: Misato asks Bright to pass her regards to children who supported Asuka; no request reversal.

rows.en: Yes, I will.
Then I'll take my leave.
...We've finally finished one job, Captain Bright.
Yes. Now we just have to transport the D-Weapons.
Captain, we have an incoming transmission from Commander Misumaru of the Federation Space Force.
rows.notes: Federation Space Force literal expansion of organization label; Misumaru title source Commander. Source says Federation Space Force, not the longer Earth Federation label; compositional organization name retained.

rows.en: Understood. Put it through to me.
...Captain Bright, I see you've safely joined up with the D-Weapons transport force.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Yes, though quite a few things happened along the way...
Now, about the reason for my call...
We just received a formal request from Director Watari of TERRA, the strategic research organization combating Mu.
rows.notes: TERRA institutional purpose kept, not compressed to bare proper name.

rows.en: You'll participate in Operation Overlord, which TERRA and the Federation military are carrying out.
So it came to that after all...
Commander Kunugi of TERRA will explain the details of your mission, but...
rows.notes: Trailing mission explanation continues into inserted555 supporting squadron inside TOKYO JUPITER.

rows.en: Commander Misumaru, what happens to our mission to transport the D-Weapons to Chongqing?
Of course, you'll resume it once Operation Overlord is complete.
But that means the D-Weapons will arrive later than scheduled...
rows.notes: Douglas objection about delayed D-Weapons arrival trails off as source.

rows.en: Operation Overlord takes top priority right now. Besides...
The Earth forces also report that their production facilities for the mass-produced models aren't fully ready yet.
rows.notes: Earth forces is literal 地球軍; no expansion to Earth Federation Army. Production-readiness delay retains subject, status and mass-production specificity.

rows.en: In other words... you want us and the D-Weapons to act as decoys and buy time?
rows.notes: Douglas explicitly interprets force and prototypes as decoys to buy time; inserted567 confirms.

rows.en: That's just like the One Year War...
rows.notes: Thought uses thought=True; Bright remembers the One Year War situation.

rows.en: Giganos exploited the Space Force's postwar cleanup of the Neo Zeon and Baam wars to invade Earth...
rows.notes: Space Force was preoccupied by two wars' aftermath; invasion causal relation retained.

rows.en: And the Earth forces lost all face fighting the Angel. That's why we cannot allow Operation Overlord to fail.
rows.notes: Earth forces is literal 地球軍; no additional Federation label inserted. Lost-face imperative retained.

rows.en: ...Colonel. After the postwar cleanup of the Neo Zeon and Baam wars, now this mission...
rows.notes: Misumaru lead-in continues into793 apology; source fragment retained.

rows.en: I'm truly sorry that I haven't even been able to give you leave.
I intend to have the Nadesico B join you once its trials are over, but...
rows.notes: Route insertions73-74 directly before794 establish Nadesico B and Hisago Plan test operation; restored full referent.

rows.en: Before that, I'll send reinforcements to the Nahel Argama.
What kind of reinforcements do you mean?
rows.notes: Complete question restored from bare reinforcements interrogative.

rows.en: Yes, of course. The Mazinger Team, the Getter Team... and Reideen.
rows.notes: Answers inserted77 about veterans of three empires; three team names retained.

rows.en: That's right. From now on, you'll operate under my command as an independent super robot force.
rows.notes: Independent super robot force retains usual 特機 convention in force-assignment context.

rows.en: Understood, sir.
Along with that, I've asked GEAR to provide you with support.
rows.notes: Misumaru has asked GEAR to support Bright's independent force; request direction retained.

rows.en: GEAR... I've heard they're a research organization working on an Earth Sphere defense network against alien invasions...
rows.notes: Bright knows the public research role; reused432-434 establishes surprise at GEAR's military strength.

rows.en: Please ask Chief Shibuya at GEAR for the details.
With their support, the super robot pilots joining your ship should find it easier to get things done.
rows.notes: GEAR support eases activity for the joining super robot pilots; not a claim that GEAR joins the ship.

rows.en: Understood. Thank you for your consideration.
And there's one more thing...
I hear you went out of your way to send flowers for my daughter, Yurika.
rows.notes: Reused80-81 confirms the flowers commemorate deceased Yurika.

rows.en: It was no trouble... I never had a chance to meet your daughter in person, but... she helped bring the Lizard War to an end.
rows.notes: Bright never met Yurika personally; he credits her contribution to ending the war.

rows.en: If the ceasefire treaty with the Jovian Federation hadn't been signed after that, the Earth Sphere would be in even worse shape now.
My daughter would be pleased to hear that from you, the former captain of the White Base...
rows.notes: Would be pleased retains Misumaru's reflection on his deceased daughter.

rows.en: Yes, sir. Once the super robot team arrives, we'll rendezvous with TERRA's special operations aircraft carrier.
rows.notes: Rendezvous follows arrival of the super robot team; no invented carrier name.

rows.en: ...We've got newcomers coming now? Is that really true?
Yes. Light told me about it a little while ago.
I hear it's a team of super robots.
rows.notes: Super robot follows campaign convention for special machines.

rows.en: Super robots...? What does that mean?
It's what people call robots like Mazinger Z and Getter Robo.
rows.notes: Defines the familiar term with Mazinger Z and Getter Robo examples without duplicating technical jargon.

rows.en: Getter Robo? What's that?
You don't know? It's the super robot that was fighting the Dinosaur Empire on Earth until recently.
Oh, huh...
...You guys should learn a little about what's going on in the world.
We got this job right after the final battle with Haman, didn't we? When would we have had the time?
Quit complaining, Beecha. We all agreed to help Bright until the fighting with Giganos was over, remember?
rows.notes: Judau reminds Beecha of their agreement to help Bright until the Giganos conflict ends.

rows.en: Sure, but... if we come down to Earth, we're gonna end up fighting other people too, you know?
It can't be helped. If the fighting's going to happen no matter what, we just have to end it as soon as we can.
rows.notes: Judau wants the inevitable conflict ended quickly, not a new fight started.

rows.en: I'm not about to sit around and watch without doing anything.
Big brother...
rows.notes: Leina addresses her brother; familial address retained.

rows.en: Man, you've sure got plenty of energy.
But that's exactly how Judau managed to save Ple and Ple Two. You know that too, don't you?
rows.notes: Judau's active resolve enabled him to save both Ple and Ple Two.

rows.en: Y-yeah.
Looks like they're here.
Look, Ple Two, look! There's a big UFO and a little UFO coming!
The big one doesn't look Earth-made. Could it belong to the Baam?
rows.notes: Earth-made is Ple Two's impression, and Baam ownership is her guess, not narration.

rows.en: I don't know... I don't think so.
...So this is the Nahel Argama... It's bigger than I expected.
Yeah. It couldn't handle our machine if it weren't this big.
rows.notes: Shared protagonist machine handled by carrier; one machine with pilot/co-pilot.

rows.en: Oh... could that be...?
rows.notes: Recognition trails off before Koji identifies himself.

rows.en: I think he's... Mazinger Z's pilot...

rows.en: Yeah, I'm Koji Kabuto. Nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Introduction greeting; no reversed cooperation request.

rows.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Iino Abbav. Um, Kabuto...
rows.notes: Full Iino name follows glossary; trailing Kabuto address retained.

rows.en: You can just call me Koji.
Th-then, Koji... where is your Mazinger Z?
rows.notes: Restores where-is question predicate for Mazinger Z.

rows.en: Oh, it's at the Robot Museum in Atami right now.
A museum, huh? So that's why you're flying that UFO?
It's a TFO, a TFO. I built it when I was at the Watson Institute in America.
rows.notes: Koji built the TFO himself while at the Watson research facility in America. Short source form of Watson Science Institute introduced in row526; follows root-sourced terminology.
uncertain: Watson Institute follows the shortened source form and established project rendering; independent canonical English provenance remains unverified.

rows.en: Huh... So that thing was made on Earth.
Yeah. Pretty cool, right?
So did you build that huge UFO too, Koji?
rows.notes: Judau asks about the larger UFO, not the small TFO just discussed.

rows.en: N-no, that one's... Anyway, let me introduce the others.
rows.notes: Koji trails off about the larger craft, then changes topic.

rows.en: I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名...

rows.en: I'm the co-pilot of that #機体名 over there.
rows.notes: Co-pilot of the named unit; runtime unit placeholder unchanged.

rows.en: I'm Second Lieutenant #男姓名. I'll be counting on you from now on.
rows.notes: Restores forward cooperation request with speaker relying on listeners; male full-name placeholder unchanged.

rows.en: ...By the way, can I ask you something?
What is it?
Why are kids like you on a warship?
rows.notes: Female lead is surprised by children serving aboard a warship.

rows.en: Why...? Because I'm a mobile suit pilot.
rows.notes: Judau explicitly states he is a mobile suit pilot.

rows.en: What!?
By the way, I'm a pilot too.
rows.notes: Restores Beecha's pilot role from Judau's statement.

rows.en: I'm a pilot too!
rows.notes: Restores Ple's pilot role from the ongoing exchange.

rows.en: Y-you are...!? Are you piloting Gundam types!?
rows.notes: Restores piloting action; Gundam-type is the class referred to.

rows.en: Yeah, that's right.
Gundam-type pilots are aces, aren't they? So why...?
rows.notes: Question deliberately trails off before male lead explains age precedents.

rows.en: I hear even Amuro Ray was fifteen or sixteen when he first piloted the original Gundam...
rows.notes: Amuro was fifteen or sixteen; preserves approximate age rather than choosing one.

rows.en: So there's nothing particularly strange about it.
Besides, I was only a little older than them when I first went into battle myself.
I-is that so...
Ryo and I are about that age too. In fact, isn't it pretty much the average around here?
rows.notes: Koji says his and the Getter team's ages are roughly average aboard. Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.

rows.en: Th-then, I... might be raising the average age...
rows.notes: Thought: female lead realizes her age may raise the average.

rows.en: ...By the way, I heard this ship has some new machines aboard... What are they?
rows.notes: Restores question about the new machines aboard the ship.

rows.en: You mean the Dragonars? Are you interested in them?
Yeah. I am a test pilot, after all.
So the idea is to use a set of three machines to handle all kinds of combat.
rows.notes: Three complementary machines cover varied combat; reused32-34 explains close combat, long-range support and electronic warfare.

rows.en: The Federation Space Force seems to be putting a lot of effort into developing its next mainstay unit too.
rows.notes: Next mainstay unit refers to next principal combat hardware, not a single specifically named unit.

rows.en: I hear their designer, Dr. Plato, brought them over to the Federation.
rows.notes: Designer brought the Giganos machines to the Federation; reused37 corrects assumption of Federation development. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Piloting the enemy's most advanced machines... Their pilots must be incredibly skilled elites.
rows.notes: Female lead assumes expert elite pilots based on the hardware; source scene soon disproves her image.

rows.en: Look, Kaine. There's a whole row of super robots.
Yeah. Their paint jobs put even D-1 to shame.
rows.notes: Their colors are even more striking than D-1's.

rows.en: And they're bigger than I expected.
Who are they?
rows.notes: Restores who-are-they question predicate.

rows.en: That's Kaine and the others, the Dragonar pilots.
rows.notes: Kaine and companions are the Dragonar pilots.

rows.en: Huh? Are you the newcomers?
rows.notes: Kaine asks whether the protagonists are the newcomers, answered by Roux outside packet.

rows.en: Yes, they're new here.
rows.notes: Roux confirms protagonists are new arrivals, answering Kaine; they subject restored.

rows.en: Then I'd better introduce myself. I'm Kaine Wakaba, the D-1 pilot.
rows.notes: Kaine introduces himself informally; full glossary name and D-1 designation retained.

rows.en: Y-you're the pilot...?
rows.notes: Female lead astonished the young Kaine is D-1 pilot after expecting elite veteran; stammer and trailing question retained.

rows.en: Hey, Kaine. Those two outrank us, you know?
rows.notes: Those two are the protagonist pilots, both above Dragonar team in rank.

rows.en: If you don't salute, Sergeant Ben will yell at you again.
rows.notes: Light tells Kaine to salute the protagonists; Sergeant Ben is glossary Ben Rooney, not Benkei.

rows.en: Oh, whoops.
rows.notes: Kaine realizes etiquette lapse; brief reaction retained.

rows.en: It's fine. I'm not going to make a fuss about rank.
rows.notes: Male lead accepts informality rather than demanding salute.

rows.en: Besides, it looks like there are plenty of people here who aren't in the military.
rows.notes: Many aboard are not military personnel, explaining relaxed treatment.

rows.en: You get it! Uh, let's see...
rows.notes: Kaine approves male lead leniency then trails off seeking his name.

rows.en: I'm #男姓名. And this is #女姓名.
rows.notes: Male lead gives his own full name and introduces female lead; exact full-name placeholders preserved.

rows.en: Uh, I'm Airman Third Class Tapp Oceano, sir! I'm the D-2 pilot!
rows.notes: Tapp conspicuously adopts formal reporting register; Airman Third Class is sourced rank, not lieutenant.

rows.en: I'm Airman Third Class Light Newman, the D-3 pilot.
rows.notes: Light follows formal self-introduction; full glossary name and rank preserved.

rows.en: Hey, you guys! You're trying to make yourselves look like the good ones!
rows.notes: Kaine accuses other two of improving their own image at his expense.

rows.en: ...And together, we're known as Dragonar's Three Musketeers, sir!
rows.notes: Tapp invents Dragonar Three Musketeers boast. Literal playful nickname, immediately disclaimed by Light; no external established title asserted.

rows.en: Hey, come on. Nobody calls us that.
rows.notes: Light explicitly denies anyone calls them the invented nickname.

rows.en: Man, you're such a smooth talker.
rows.notes: Kaine calls Tapp a smooth talker; opportunistic conversational tone retained.

rows.en: You're the last person I want to hear that from!
rows.notes: Tapp responds specifically to Kaine: least entitled critic, not rejection of all criticism.

rows.en: M-more kids... And they're pilots, too...
rows.notes: Private thought reacting to another group of child pilots; stammer and deliberately shocked noun phrase retained, then explicit they are pilots.

rows.en: By the way, #女愛称, why are you dressed like that?
rows.notes: Kaine asks female lead about revealing outfit; next shared thought/comment rows478-479 read for context.

rows.en: This isn't a swimsuit. It's the outfit I need to use DFC with the machine.
rows.notes: Female lead corrects swimsuit assumption; outfit required for DFC with machine. DFC retained exactly as glossary term.

rows.en: Huh... The Earth Federation Army sure has style.
rows.notes: Tapp amused at Federation military style, referring to suit revealing appearance.

rows.notes: Kaine contrasts male lead ordinary-looking clothes; subsequent shared rows483-486 read before deciding referent.

rows.en: Anyway, I'll be counting on you from now on.
rows.notes: Koji asks Dragonar team for future cooperation; I will be counting on you preserves request direction.

rows.en: Yeah, I'm counting on you too.
rows.notes: Kaine reciprocates Koji request; not an offer to rely on Kaine alone.

rows.notes: Bridge discussion begins; Bright identifies another alien force distinct from Baam.

rows.notes: Daisuke identifies recent frequent Japan-region UFOs as Vegan reconnaissance craft, not entire fleet.

rows.en: They're a military force formed by King Vega to conquer the entire universe.
rows.notes: King Vega is glossary mapping for full Japanese title; universal-conquest objective and formation retained.

rows.notes: Bright asks whether King Vega now targets Earth; next omitted shared exchange read in route order.

rows.en: Yes. If this goes on, they'll invade and conquer this planet... and bring it under their rule.
rows.notes: Daisuke predicts invasion, conquest and rule if unchecked; all three preserved.

rows.en: Yes... Just like all those other planets they've targeted so far...
rows.notes: Deliberate comparison continuation to other targeted planets retained.

rows.en: There's one thing I'm wondering about.

rows.notes: Ben reacts to new aliens as Overlord is about to begin.

rows.en: On that subject... Besides fighting aliens, you'll...
rows.notes: Bright sentence intentionally continues into913; alien battles are additional to Federation operations.

rows.en: be taking part in various Earth Federation Army operations, starting with Operation Overlord.
rows.notes: Completes instruction from912, keeping Federation Army operations and Overlord as first example.

rows.notes: Ryoma accepts because Federation is protecting Earth Sphere peace.

rows.en: Given the times we're in, I only hope that, as with the Baam...
rows.notes: Douglas wish begins and continues into916; Baam peace is precedent, not goal left unresolved.

rows.en: we can make peace with the Vegan Empire as well.
